fields.description: A disabled rule is kept for reference but never evaluated.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Grouping only — it does not change how the rule is enforced.
fields.label: Category
fields.options:

fields.description: Refusing is the only action. A matching call is aborted before the tool runs and the agent is told why.
fields.label: Action

fields.description: One protected DocType per line. The rule fires when any argument of the tool call names one of these, at any depth — matched whole and case-insensitively, never as a substring. Optional if Parameter Limits is set.
fields.label: Restricted DocTypes

fields.description: One tool name per line to scope this rule to those tools only. LEAVE EMPTY to apply it to every tool — that is the safer default.
fields.label: Only These Tools

fields.description: Numeric bounds on the arguments a tool is called with, one per line, as `parameter <op> number` — e.g. `amount <= 5000`. Operators: <=, <, >=, >. A rule with no bounds here checks nothing numeric. If the argument is present but cannot be read as a number the call is refused: an unverifiable amount is not a safe one.
fields.label: Parameter Limits

fields.description: What the agent is told when the call is refused. Say what was blocked, not how the rule works. Leave empty for a generated message.
fields.label: Violation Message

fields.description: Agents this rule does NOT apply to. Use sparingly — an exemption is a hole in the control. Example: Logix authors Server Scripts for a living, so the Code Execution rule must exempt it.
fields.label: Exempt Agents
